model: Two nominal P-CREW at BASE-01, two aircraft requiring separate two-hour crew-dependent preparation from hour 23.5 for a planned 28-29 formation, one seed and a 36-hour horizon. DRAOS=N. The active ResourceStationData.SHPID link is removed in all variants, leaving shift definition source tables unreferenced; native evidence must verify no active shift behavior. Other configuration stays inherited from accepted C07.var04 explicit input.

lineage.no-shift-control: Accepted C07 input except SHPID CREW-DAY to null and description.
lineage.zero-budget: No-shift control except Resource.MUTILF null to 0 and description.
lineage.finite-budget: No-shift control except Resource.MUTILF null to 0.03125 and description.
lineage.station-override: Finite-budget input except ResourceStationData.MUTILF null to 1 and description. Resource.MUTILF remains 0.03125.

pre_run_hypotheses.no-shift-control: With no active shift and default daily utilization 1, both aircraft can prepare continuously from 23.5 to 25.5 and complete the 28-29 formation.
pre_run_hypotheses.zero-budget: A zero daily budget may stop crew-dependent preparation immediately, causing the scheduled mission to fail or cancel; converter acceptance must be checked separately.
pre_run_hypotheses.finite-budget: MUTILF=0.03125 gives 0.75 hour per crew and 1.5 crew-hours for the two-crew pool per 24-hour day. After the hour-24 daily reset, work may stop at 24.75 with 0.75 hour left for each aircraft and stay pending through the 36-hour horizon; exact native events determine whether the 28-29 mission can proceed.
pre_run_hypotheses.station-override: Station MUTILF=1 should override Resource.MUTILF=0.03125 at BASE-01 and restore the no-shift control timing and results.

acceptance_requires: accepted parent and exact per-variant business deltas frozen before native execution
guarded serial session-0 SSH execution and preservation of GUI PID 13340
exact native import/export roundtrip of all row-containing source tables
zero conversion errors and valid nonempty result/report for each positively accepted input
event proof of actual usage stop or lack of stop and mission/terminal outcome
resource pool-hour and waiting ledgers with system/stock report bins
sealed raw artifact hashes and independent read-only replay without author imports
limitations: This is a fixed-seed, two-aircraft, one-resource, one-station probe with preparation beginning near an elapsed-day boundary.
A successful result will not establish general daily reset, all MUTILF values, sequential task scheduling, multiple resources/stations, shift/no-shift interactions or cross-engine equivalence.
